confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from web searches. These were crowdsourced cost-of-living sites (cappuccino about A$4.5-4.75, domestic draught beer about A$8-9, inexpensive meal about A$18-25, mid-range dinner for two about A$72) and happy-hour or venue listings. Because the sources are crowdsourced and the listings may be dated, I adjusted upward for current Byron Bay tourist pricing. I found no standard full-price glass of wine or cocktail figure. Cocktail and wine are based on the beer price relationship plus the venue listings: about A$22-25 cocktails at an upscale venue, and $14-16 at happy hour. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings, and Byron Bay prices swing strongly with season and events, so they are the least certain. The FX figure is the RBA US dollar rate of 0.6720 for 2026-11-18, found in search results from RBA pages.
comparable_city_reasoning: Byron Bay is a premium coastal tourist town in northern NSW. Its prices are close to Sydney for drinks and accommodation, and somewhat lower for restaurant meals. Accommodation is estimated near Gold Coast and Noosa levels, with a premium for the Byron Bay location.
